newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's Manos calls for regulator resignations.
newsitem.headline: Greece's Manos calls for regulator resignations.

text.p: Former conservative National Economy Minister Stephanos Manos called for the resignation of the heads of the Athens stock exchange, the capital markets commission and the supervisory authority on Thursday.
In an interview with Flash radio, Manos blamed the recent bourse crisis on the failure of all regulatory bodies to do their job.
National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou has the ultimate responsibility for the crisis because he oversees and makes appointments to regulatory bodies, he said.
Manos added that he favoured the cleansing of the bourse even if this entailed its closure for a few more days.

Trading re-started at the Athens bourse on Wednesday with more and more firms being admitted to the floor and having their terminals switched on after normal trading came to a halt for three consecutive business days.
